profile.headline: Senior Mobile Engineer
profile.summary: Senior mobile engineer with 9 years of iOS experience and growing Android expertise, building production applications across both platforms. Specializes in SwiftUI architecture, shared mobile frameworks, and consistent cross-platform UI. Proven track record delivering pixel-perfect interfaces, reducing cross-project code duplication, and collaborating across design, backend, and QA teams.

positions.title: Backend Developer
positions.description:
- Build data integration scripts moving records between platform APIs (Teamwork, Discord, WordPress), including automated content migration from an existing site into WordPress
- Debug and fix custom WordPress blocks (PHP/JavaScript), maintain GitLab CI for a client Flutter app, and deliver site content and SEO improvements communicated directly to client stakeholders
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · WordPress · JavaScript · Wix Website Builder · Gitlab

positions.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to white-label mobile frameworks used across multiple client products, including color scheme systems, reusable UI components, and reusable features
- Migrated complex business logic from an existing iOS app into a shared Kotlin Multiplatform module to support a new Android app, and added accessibility tags to enable consistent automated UI testing across both platforms
- Developed SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose features from Figma designs, supporting light/dark mode, brand-specific assets, and brand-specific screen variations across multiple client apps
- Contributed mocked models that other developers used across the codebase, and built additional preview tooling for rapid UI iteration across brands, color schemes, and view model states without waiting on backend
- Architected local data persistence and offline sync workflows in SQLite using Swift Concurrency for a client app supporting on-site photo capture and upload, and implemented sync logic within the shared Kotlin Multiplatform module for another client app
- Conducted code reviews and supported junior team members through pair programming and troubleshooting
positions.insights: Skills: Swift · SwiftUI · Xcode · Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · Android Studio · Figma · SQLite

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description:
- Sole mobile developer responsible for three iOS apps and one Android app, built from the ground up around a shared app framework with middleware providing reusable services across projects
- Architected an offline-first queueing system for forms and orders, using ReSwift for state management to keep UIKit views in sync under iOS 11 support constraints
- Built UI programmatically for reusability and flexibility, with Dynamic Type support for accessible form input
- Built a C# backend and SQL Server database that synced with IBM Domino, providing the REST API consumed by the mobile clients
- Owned the full mobile development lifecycle, including testing, TestFlight distribution, and App Store releases
positions.insights: Skills: Swift · UIKit · Xcode · Kotlin · Android Studio · C# · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Chester, Ohio, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Built a real-time temperature monitoring dashboard with MySQL-backed web visualizations and automated reporting
- Contributed to PHP backend services, iOS and Android apps, and SQL Server stored procedures across multiple client projects
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · MySQL · Chart.js · Unix · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
- Delivered iOS features and bug fixes for multiple clients including Kroger using Swift, implementing interfaces from Sketch designs
- Applied unidirectional data flow architecture (ReSwift) and reactive programming (RxSwift) patterns within the Kroger codebase
- Designed an alternative VoiceOver interaction for a timer interface, replacing swipe-based controls with an accessible input method

positions.title: iOS Developer Internship
positions.description:
- Adopted Swift shortly after its introduction, navigating early language instability across major version changes while shipping features for client applications
- Built proficiency in UIKit and Auto Layout through hands-on client work and code reviews with senior developers

honors.title: 2nd in BPA State Competition - Java Programming
honors.description: State Level - Utilize structured designs to develop software using the JAVA programming language.
honors.issuer: Issued by Business Professionals of America · Jan 2013
